- [S0452] types=[CONCEPT, EXAMPLE] scope=OBJECT — "Confucian lens: the observer's role/authority/responsibility/purpose (not merely identity) must be preserved, illustrated by contrasting a security-engineer/independent-auditor compliance observation with the same observation made by a marketing team for marketing material, which carries a different epistemic context." (anchor: "Someone asks the question, chooses the measurement, selects the sample, interprets the result, decides whether the result is sufficient, acts upon it. ... (anchor: "This does NOT mean 'trust the person'. ... The role and relationship of the observer are themselves part of the situation that must be known.")
- [S0452] types=[CONCEPT, EXTENSION] scope=CROSS-OBJECT — "Reframes AI's role from evidence collector to 'Epistemic Inquiry Assistant' whose job is to ask what we're trying to know, how something was observed, what was selected/excluded, what the situation was, what changed, what would contradict the claim, what alternatives exist, what remains unknown, and what evidence would reduce uncertainty -- only afterward collecting/searching/measuring; extended into an agent workflow (Question->Inquiry Formulation->Evidence Need->Acquisition Design->Collection->Provenance Capture->Selection Audit->Contradiction Search->Alternative Explanation->Evidence Assessment->Knowledge Update) that a Verification Engine should confirm was not bypassed."
